sanskrit:
तत्र सत्त्वं निर्मलत्वात्प्रकाशकमनामयम् ।
सुखसङ्गेन बध्नाति ज्ञानसङ्गेन चानघ ॥ १४-६॥
iast:
tatra sattvaṃ nirmalatvāt prakāśakamanāmayam
sukhasaṅgena badhnāti jñānasaṅgena cānagha 14-6
translation: Of these, SATTWA which because of its stainlessness is luminous and healthy (unobstructive) . It binds by (creating) attachment to happiness and attachment to knowledge  O sinless one.
